supported.length: positive integer, bounded by the adapter's memory/dispatch limits
supported.steps: any positive integer; default 16; nstep=20 is equivalent to the wrapper path
supported.noiseScale: finite nonnegative; default 0.45; applies to fresh centered Gaussian noise at each multistep iteration
supported.foldConditioning: C/A/T embedding row indices; named CATH code requires caller-supplied upstream vocabulary
supported.cathMasking: null rows 5/43/1472 allow C-only, C+A, or C+A+T conditioning
supported.outputs: C-alpha coordinates in nm; PDB coordinates in Angstroms; full predicted-coordinate trajectory

comparison: raw unaligned coordinates; identical recorded Gaussian draws and identically quantized weights
